Metamorphasis

Metamorphosis is a short design look book, about redesigning commonly thrown away items into somethings new.

Concept

These designs are made to bring awareness to the unsustainable practices of fast fashion, shining light on the harm caused. Moreover, inspiring readers to create their own unique designs by up-cycling their own clothing.
Below are my moodboard and preliminary sketches.

Designs and Mockups

These mockups were done to give the audience a view of what the design's would look like when applied to real clothing
